v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cantáte * Dómino et benedícite nómini eius.
text.en: Sing ye * to the Lord and bless his name.
The salvation of my countenance * and my God.

text.la: Illúmina, Dómine, * vultum tuum super nos.
text.en: May the Lord shine the light * of his countenance upon us.

text.la: Exaltáte * Regem sæculórum in opéribus vestris.
text.en: Give ye glory to him * in your works.

text.la: Laudáte * nomen Dómini, qui statis in domo Dómini.
text.en: Praise * the name of the Lord, ye who stand in the house of the Lord.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Eréxit nobis * Dóminus cornu salútis in domo David púeri sui.
text.en: The Lord has raised up * a horn of salvation for us in the house of David his servant.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui cæléstia simul et terréna moderáris: supplicatiónes pópuli tui cleménter exáudi; et pacem tuam nostris concéde tempóribus.
text.en: Almighty and eternal God, as thou govern all things in heaven and on earth; in thy mercy hear the supplication of thy people, and grant thy peace in our times.

title.la: Ss. Marii, Marthæ, Audifacis, et Abachum Martyrum
title.en: Ss. Marius, Martha, Audifax, and Abachum, Martyrs

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Exáudi, Dómine, pópulum tuum cum Sanctórum tuórum patrocínio supplicántem: ut et temporális vitæ nos tríbuas pace gaudére; et ætérnæ reperíre subsídium.
text.en: Graciously hear, O Lord, the prayers of thy people who draw near unto thee under the protection of thy blessed Saints, granting us in this world thy peace, and in that which is to come life everlasting.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Deus, qui ad illustrándam Ecclésiam tuam beátum Canútum regem martýrii palma et gloriósis miráculis decoráre dignátus es: concéde propítius; ut, sicut ipse Domínicæ passiónis imitátor fuit, ita nos, per eius vestígia gradiéntes, ad gáudia sempitérna perveníre mereámur.
text.en: O God, who, for the greater glory of Thy Church, wast pleased to adorn blessed Canute the king with the palm of martyrdom and with glorious miracles: mercifully grant that, walking in the footsteps of him who followed our Lord in His sufferings, we may thereby deserve to attain to eternal joys.

office.title: Feria III infra Hebd II post Epiphaniam
